description: Lists word lists as summaries (id, title, language, section, grade range, placement basis code, word count, page URL) without their words; returns { count, note, lists } in dataset order, all matches, no paging. Use this to discover ids, then get_word_list for one list's words; use get_words_for_grade or find_words instead when you want words directly. Filters combine with AND. A grade is a typical guide, not a rule: programs and standards differ, and it is not an assessment of any child. English lists are placed by grade; lists in other languages follow each language's own curriculum and have no grade.

grade.description: Keep only English lists whose grade range includes this grade; other-language lists have no grade and are excluded. Omit for all grades.

language.description: Language code: en, de, es, fr, nl or pt-br. Omit for all languages.

section.description: cvc, families, sight, digraphs or patterns (English), or wordlist (every other-language list). Omit for all sections.

name: list_word_lists
title: List word lists
